words.gloss_range: comes forth, emerges, issues out; locally intransitive and sourced by the following dual prepositional phrase
words.root_gloss_range: broad root range around going out, bringing out, yield, outlet, and related side-branches; the local Form I clause selects emergence rather than extraction
words.prose: {{ar:يَخْرُجُ}} ({{tr:yakhruju}}) opens the ayah with emergence before inventory. Its imperfect Form I makes the sea-yielding event sound recurrent and open, and the delayed compound subject lets pearl and coral appear as what comes forth rather than as objects already extracted. The immediate source phrase after the verb makes origin the first relation heard. Broader {{ar:خ ر ج}} ({{tr:kh-r-j}}) evidence adds yield and outlet pressure, so the products read as hidden marine value becoming manifest, while local grammar keeps the selected sense to intransitive emergence. Variant readings that passive or causativize the verb expose an extraction-agency contrast, but the standard surface leaves agency grammatically unspoken. The verb also turns the prior two-seas release in 55:19 into visible output after the refrain, with wider provision parallels such as 6:95, 7:57, and 35:27 remaining comparative rather than controlling.

topics.headline: intransitive recurring emergence
topics.summary: The imperfect Form I verb makes the products the delayed subject of a recurring emergence event.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first hears an ongoing coming-forth process, then learns that pearl and coral themselves fill the subject role.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the verb as an imperfect intransitive predicate whose delayed subject is the coordinated product pair.

topics.headline: source heard before subject
topics.summary: The source phrase comes between the verb and the named products, making origin precede identification.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader resolves the two-sea source before receiving the identity of what emerges from it.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement is syntactically attached to the verb and precedes the explicit compound subject.

topics.headline: yield and outlet pressure
topics.summary: Root-family yield and outlet senses make the emergence productive, while the local clause does not activate every branch of the root.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb can suggest a source yielding visible output, not only motion away from a place.
topics.reason: V4 supports yield and outlet as accepted root-family branches, but the local Form I frame with no object selects emergence rather than tax, abscess, saddlebag, or other side-branches.

topics.headline: variant extraction agency
topics.summary: Passive and causative readings show a real extraction-agency contrast without replacing the standard intransitive parse.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the standard wording foregrounds self-manifesting products, while accepted variants can make bringing-out agency explicit or passive.
topics.reason: Variant readings may be used for contrast, but the local standard surface is intransitive with the products as subject.

topics.headline: provision and motion echoes
topics.summary: The verb joins a wider coming-forth pattern and turns the earlier two-seas release into a product event.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah as marine provision emerging from the earlier released seas, with wider coming-forth scenes as comparison.
topics.reason: Contextual and CRITICAL rows support provision-pattern comparison, but cross-ayah echoes remain comparative and do not alter the local grammar.

topics.headline: refrain becomes evidence
topics.summary: After the prior refrain, the ayah shifts from addressed challenge into impersonal natural declaration.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated challenge giving way to a concrete event that can stand as evidence of favor.
topics.reason: The clause is an impersonal verbal declaration following the refrain and resumes the two-seas scene through a product event.

words.gloss_range: from both of them; the preposition marks source and the dual suffix resumes the two seas
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُمَا}} ({{tr:minhumā}}) fuses source marking with dual reference. The preposition marks the origin of the emergence, while the attached suffix sends the reader back to the two seas in 55:19 rather than to the two products that follow. Because this word stands between the verb and the product names, the clause asks the reader to recover the source first: from both of them, then pearl and coral. The phrase therefore carries the two-seas thread across the intervening refrain in 55:21 without repeating the noun, and it keeps both prior seas active as the shared source. Its repeated nasal sounds also make the source phrase audibly lean toward the final marine product.

topics.headline: dual source anaphor
topics.summary: The fused preposition and dual suffix mark the two prior seas as the source of emergence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the source is specifically both earlier seas, not generic water and not the pearl-coral pair.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the dual suffix to the earlier two-seas referent and attaches the phrase as the verb's source complement.

topics.headline: source before products
topics.summary: Placed between verb and subject, the phrase makes source resolution precede product identification.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the clause as a sourced event before the treasure names arrive.
topics.reason: Local word order places the governed source phrase immediately after the verb and before the nominative product subject.

topics.headline: refrain-crossing bridge
topics.summary: The dual suffix carries the two-seas referent across the intervening refrain.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the four-ayah two-seas sequence connected even after the refrain in 55:21 interrupts it, with the source phrase also audibly leaning into the marine close.
topics.reason: The suffix supplies anaphoric continuity to the earlier two-seas scene and the source phrase remains audible as a compact bridge.

words.gloss_range: the pearl, pearl as a known concrete category; locally nominative subject and first product in the pair
words.root_gloss_range: rare noun-only pearl lexeme with reduplicated sound-shape; no V4 guardrail rows were supplied for this root
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ}} ({{tr:al-luʾluʾu}}) is not an extracted object in the standard reading; its nominative case makes pearl the first named subject of the emergence. The definite singular form names pearl as a recognized category, and its position after the source phrase lets it answer the expectation created by 'from both of them.' Its reduplicated {{ar:ل ؤ ل ؤ}} ({{tr:l-ʾ-l-ʾ}}) shape and repeated hamza stops make the word feel bead-like and segmented in sound as well as sense; variant case and hamza treatments show how objecthood or smoother recitation would change that pressure without changing the pearl referent. Distributionally, the rare noun-only lexeme grounds later pearl imagery: the pearl associated with preserved or scattered beauty in 52:24, 56:23, and 76:19 is here shown at its earthly sea-source.

topics.headline: pearl as emerging subject
topics.summary: The nominative definite noun makes pearl a known category and the first subject of the emergence verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees pearl as what comes forth, not as an object merely pulled from the sea.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as a definite nominative noun functioning as subject of the verb.

topics.headline: first product category
topics.summary: The word names the pearl category as the first half of an ordered marine product pair.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices pearl beginning a paired taxonomy of sea-products rather than standing as a lone treasure term.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and conjoined with the following product, supporting a paired product reading.

topics.headline: bead-like sound shape
topics.summary: Reduplication and repeated hamza stops make the pearl word carry object-like texture in its sound and form.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the pearl word itself as segmented and bead-like, matching the concrete object it names.
topics.reason: The quadriliteral reduplicated root and surface hamzas support a formal sound-shape payoff; no V4 root rows were supplied to narrow it further.

topics.headline: variant case and hamza contrast
topics.summary: Variant case and hamza treatments expose formal pressure while the standard surface remains nominative pearl with internal hamzas.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how case can reparse pearl as extracted object and how hamza smoothing changes sound without changing the pearl referent.
topics.reason: Accepted variants are useful for contrast, but they do not replace the standard nominative, internally hamzated surface.

topics.headline: earthly anchor for pearl imagery
topics.summary: A rare noun-only pearl lexeme is grounded here in sea emergence before it appears in adornment and paradise imagery.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a word often used for elevated beauty is here tied to a concrete marine origin.
topics.reason: Contextual evidence marks the lexeme as rare and noun-concrete, while the CRITICAL rows provide concrete cross-reference comparisons.

topics.headline: abstract favor made concrete
topics.summary: The named pearl turns the surrounding favor-register into a visible precious object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the refrain's abstract favor language land in a named, luminous sea object.
topics.reason: The product noun follows the refrain and carries concrete object, sound, and rarity payoffs together.

words.gloss_range: and; coordinating particle joining the second product to the first as a shared subject
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the small hinge that prevents the second product from becoming a separate clause or an appositional rename. It carries coral into the same nominative subject relation as pearl, so both products share the one emergence verb. The coordination is additive without ranking: pearl and coral stand as co-products from the same source, with their difference preserved inside one compound subject. Because the particle is prefixed onto the coral noun in recitation and writing, the second item enters as joined but still distinct.

topics.headline: coordinated compound subject
topics.summary: The conjunction joins coral to pearl as a co-equal subject of the emergence verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees two distinct products sharing one emergence, not a second clause or an explanation of the first product.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second product as conjoined to the first and sharing its subject role.

topics.headline: additive unranked pairing
topics.summary: The particle creates a balanced two-item product structure without subordinating coral to pearl.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices paired variety rather than a single undifferentiated treasure category.
topics.reason: The coordinating particle supplies addition and parallelism, not comparison, sequence, or subordination.

topics.headline: attached audible bridge
topics.summary: The prefixed conjunction visibly and audibly brings the second product into the pair.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second product enter through a bridge rather than as an isolated restart.
topics.reason: The conjunction is a proclitic on the second noun and performs the syntactic joining described by the rows.

words.gloss_range: coral, with a lexically noted small-pearl alternative; locally definite nominative second member of the product pair
words.root_gloss_range: root-family range around release, meeting under restraint, mixed flame, disorder, looseness, tangling, and marjan as jewel or small pearls; the local noun names the concrete marine product
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمَرْجَانُ}} ({{tr:al-marjānu}}) closes the pair as a definite nominative co-subject, not as an appended object; the accusative variant shows how case could instead make coral the thing extracted. Its sense is locally the recognized coral product, while the small-pearl dispute remains relevant because it changes the pair from two different marine substances into a large-small pearl spectrum. The {{ar:م ر ج}} ({{tr:m-r-j}}) root-field makes this closing noun especially dense in Surah 55: the same root marks mixed flame in 55:15, the releasing of the two seas in 55:19, this marine product in 55:22, and later a beauty simile in 55:58. Thus coral becomes the point where release and mixture turn into a named sea-yield. Its audible article boundary after the prefixed conjunction and its final cadence keep coral distinct while making it the closing product before the next refrain.

topics.headline: coral as co-subject
topics.summary: The definite nominative coral noun shares the subject role with pearl through coordination.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees coral as the second thing that emerges, not as an object, gloss, or syntactic afterthought.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the noun as definite, nominative, and conjoined to the first subject.

topics.headline: accusative extraction contrast
topics.summary: Accusative variant evidence shows how case could shift coral into objecthood, while the standard reading keeps it as co-subject.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that coral's role depends on case: standard nominative makes it emerge, while the variant can make it extracted.
topics.reason: The qiraat contrast is valid apparatus, but the local standard output remains nominative.

topics.headline: coral or small-pearl tension
topics.summary: Lexical dispute over coral versus small pearls changes the shape of the pair without displacing the local coral gloss.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pair as either two marine substances or a large-small pearl spectrum, while the local surface still functions as the second product category.
topics.reason: V4 marks the marjan jewel or small-pearl branch for review, so the ambiguity is preserved as lexical tension rather than made the governing sense.

topics.headline: release becomes product
topics.summary: The root family links release, mixture, and concrete marine product, but the local noun names the product rather than all branches at once.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the earlier sea-release root return inside the coral noun as the product of that release.
topics.reason: V4 supports release, mixed flame, disorder, and marjan branches; local grammar and noun form keep the selected sense as concrete marine product.

topics.headline: same-surah root thread
topics.summary: The root recurs around mixed fire, released seas, coral product, and later beauty comparison within Surah 55.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees coral as part of a same-surah sequence from elemental mixture to sea release to product and later simile.
topics.reason: CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references, and contextual evidence marks the root as low-occurrence enough for the recurrence to matter.

topics.headline: closing product evidence
topics.summary: The final word completes the two-product structure and supplies a concrete favor for the next refrain.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader leaves the ayah with coral as the final heard evidence of the seas' yield before the refrain returns.
topics.reason: The noun is the second member and final word of the ayah, closing the product pair before the repeated refrain.

topics.headline: audible product boundary
topics.summary: The noun's sound, article boundary, and final cadence reinforce its joined-but-distinct closing role.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears coral as a distinct closing noun that still belongs audibly to the coordinated pair and refrain cadence.
topics.reason: The article remains audible after the attached conjunction, and the final sound supports the clause's closing position.

strongest_changes: The immediate sea sequence changed generic dual provenance into productive contact whose boundary prevents transgression without preventing yield.
The shared م ر ج branch between fiery مارج and focus مرجان let literal coral retain a flare-like process-memory.
Balance language activated خروج as due output, while later garden duals expanded that yield into a recurring paired ecology.
Later penetration and circular-motion scenes distinguished licensed one-way emergence from rebellious escape or trapped recurrence.
The later coral simile reversed object and image traffic, allowing focus gems to carry living optical force.
summary.what_was_special: One compact clause sustained coexisting material, epistemic, ecological, distributive, legal-spatial, chromatic, optical, and cautiously gestational readings. The most productive latent hinge was not a free symbol but the interaction of يخرج with the split branch range of مرجان and the repeated dual grammar.
remaining_uncertainties: منهما does not by itself settle whether each product belongs distributively to one source, both products arise from each, or the dual domain acts jointly.
The fiery and disorder branches of م ر ج may be audible process-memory or may be too distant from lexicalized مرجان to bear more than exploratory weight.
The garden, ship-scale, judgment-topology, and optical parallels may be deliberate recurrences or reader-supplied cross-domain analogies; the packet supports both possibilities.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Value emerging from coordinated difference.** The dual source pronoun points back to meeting-with-boundary. `م ر ج/B004` (mixture/disorder) is activated by the form `مَرْجَان`, but the noun denotes an ordered valuable output rather than confusion. I infer that constrained relation converts the threat of mixture into differentiated production. The ayah reads as boundary-enabled emergence.
2. **Exit without collapse of sources.** The verb `خ ر ج` assigns movement outward, while the sources remain dual. I infer that an output can belong to both without erasing their distinction. The ayah reads as a model of shared causation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:58 reuses coral in describing persons rather than marine output. That later transfer makes coral a portable index of formed clarity and value across domains.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`خ ر ج` `B001` — “emerge,” and `ل ء ل ء` `B001` / `B002` — “pearl” / “gleam.”** Structural cue: a singular emergence verb governs two coordinated products and the source is the dual pronoun `مِنْهُمَا`; this follows meeting-with-barrier. Assigned role: emergence makes valuable visibility an output of the bounded marine relation, while the gleam branch marks the transition from hidden source to perceptible object. Packet evidence is the source phrase, coordination, and branch inventory. Inference: regulated contact can generate or disclose value without erasing source distinctions. Reading change: the ayah is a result clause in the sea-boundary mechanism, not a detached ornament list.

2. **`م ر ج` `B006` — “tangled branches,” as a possible image activated by `ٱلْمَرْجَانُ`.** Structural cue: coral is paired with the compact pearl but differs in the inventory’s branching image; ships like raised landmarks follow in 55:24. Assigned role: the branch gives the second product an extended, interlaced profile against the pearl’s concentrated gleam. Packet evidence is the accepted branch image and noun pairing; inference: the two outputs represent contrasting forms of marine value. Reading change: the coordination can encode morphological diversity, while the ordinary coral reference remains intact.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:26–27 reclassified both marine products as finite disclosures of value whose lasting significance depends on the source that remains.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalın merkezine bilinen inciyi, tek tanesini ve çoğul biçimlerini yerleştirir; inci sahibi ya da işleyeni ile meslek adı ise bu nesne anlamına bağlı türetimlerdir. Bu düzen, verilen dal çerçevesiyle uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal inciyi bir nesne ve tür olarak tanımlar; parlama eylemi ile inciyle yalnız kullanım alanı bakımından ilişkili süs nesneleri bu çekirdeğe girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dalın anlamı incidir; kişi ve meslek adları bu çekirdeğe bağlı türetimler olarak tutulur, başka yapılara özgü parlama anlamı tanıma katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Mücevher olarak kullanılan inci, bunun tek tanesi ve tür adı bu dalın çekirdeğidir. İnci sahibi ya da işleyeni ve onun mesleği için kullanılan türemiş adlar bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Dal, bilinen inciyi hem tek bir mücevher tanesi hem de türün genel adı olarak belirtir.
İnci sahibi ya da işleyeni ile bu kişinin mesleği için nesne anlamına bağlı türemiş adlar bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı bilinen inciyi, tek tanesini ve çoğul biçimlerini verir. Aynı söz ailesinde inci sahibi ya da işleyeni ile onun mesleğini adlandıran türetimler de yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın nesne ve tür merkezli çekirdeğini doğal biçimde karşılar; kişi ve meslek adları ayrı türetimler olarak gösterilir.

error_profile.preserves: Bilinen mücevher tanesi ile bunun genel tür adını birlikte korur.

error_profile.loses: İncinin genel tür adı olarak kullanılabilmesini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnız inciyi işleme mesleği ya da işi kastedildiğinde uygun olan, çekirdeğe bağlı bir meslek anlatımıdır.

error_profile.preserves: İnciye bağlı meslek ve iş alanını korur.
error_profile.loses: İncinin kendisini ve inci sahibi ya da işleyen kişiyi karşılamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yıldızın, ateşin, şimşeğin ve başka bir şeyin görünür biçimde parlamasını ortak çekirdek olarak verir; inci parlaklığı yalnız bu görünüşü açıklayan bir benzetmedir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu eylem anlamını doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, görünür parlama olayını kapsar; inci nesnesini, kuyruk hareketini ya da yalnız ateşe bağlı tutuşma yapısını genel çekirdeğin yerine geçirmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel parlama bildiren çekimli biçimler ile ateşin tutuşmasını anlatan yapıya bağlı kullanım ayrı tutulur; ateş yapısının özel anlamı bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yıldızın, şimşeğin, ateşin ya da başka bir şeyin ışığının belirginleşerek görünür biçimde parlamasıdır. Parlaklık kimi anlatımda incinin ışığına benzetilir.

Yıldızın, şimşeğin ve ateşin parlaması bu görünür ışık olayının başlıca örnekleridir.
Bir şeyin parlaması, incinin belirgin ve canlı parlaklığına benzetilerek anlatılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği yıldız, ateş, şimşek ya da herhangi bir şeyde görülen parlama ve ışık belirginliğidir. Bir anlatım bu görünüşü incinin parlaklığına benzetir.
